infoBody:
QUICK LAUNCH
Your apps appear on the first screen. Tap a name to open it. Pinned apps show ⭐ and appear first.

MANAGE
Add an installed app by name or App Store link. You can also share an App Store link to this shortcut. Rename, pin or remove entries in Manage. Opening an App Store page does not install the app.

YOUR DATA
Private lists stay in iCloud Drive/Shortcuts/AppListPro. Changes keep a previous save. Use Backup and restore to export, import or restore. Legacy AppList_Pro.json files can be imported without changing the original.

LANGUAGES AND OFFLINE USE
Choose from 20 languages. Downloads and app searches need internet. Launching uses saved data once iCloud files are locally available, with no network check on every run. iCloud syncing can take time. Cancelling a dialog ends the session.
